set.t: Family farm block straddling the Clayton/Scott town line, adjoining a Miller parcel; about 17 mi from Boscobel. The farmstead is the building by the road junction in sec. 35 (Clayton) on the c.1915 plat; other building sites in SW sec. 35 and in sec. 36 are the alternatives. Check LiDAR for old dig holes around them. Permission: private farm, ask first.
set.pl: Family farm block straddling the Clayton/Scott town line: T10N R3W secs 35-36 (Clayton) and T9N R3W sec 2 (Scott), Crawford County, adjoining a Miller parcel in Scott sec 1; about 17 mi from Boscobel (c.1915 Hixson plat)
pinev: Farm-level: the c.1915 Hixson Crawford plat shows one contiguous family block across the town line, 167.68 ac in Scott T9N R3W sec 2 and the Clayton block in T10N R3W secs 35-36, checked against BLM PLSS; a Miller 80 ac parcel in Scott sec 1 touches both parts (about 1 km).
